review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Greenberg Traurig (GT), a global law firm with locations across the world in 15 countries, has an exciting employment opportunity for you. We offer competitive compensation and an excellent benefits package, along with the opportunity to work within an innovative and collaborative environment. Join our Technology Team as Network Engineer located in our Atlanta office. We are seeking a professional who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. The ideal candidate possesses strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in every task. With a dedicated work ethic and a can-do attitude, you will take initiative and approach challenges with confidence and resilience. Excellent communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively across teams and delivering exceptional client service. If you are someone who demonstrates initiative, adaptability, and innovation, we invite you to join our team. This role can be based in our Atlanta office on a hybrid basis. This role reports to the Director of Network Systems. Position Summary This position is responsible for the design, implementation, operation, and maintenance of enterprise level LAN, WAN, firewall, and Wi-Fi systems across a large, multi-national, multi-site organization. The Network Engineer will collaborate with infrastructure and application teams to ensure optimal network performance, security, and scalability, while also contributing to documentation, monitoring, and the ongoing migration of on-premises services to cloud and hybrid environments. Key Responsibilities Implements and supports firewall/DMZ security infrastructure, including traffic flow troubleshooting, policy analysis and security postures Implements and supports enterprise LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi systems in a large, multi-site environment Implements and supports routing infrastructure using common routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, BGP-EVPN, VxLAN Encapsulation) Administers LAN/WAN/VLAN/802.1x, Wi-Fi, VoIP, 802.1X authentication, RADIUS, Tacacs+ IPsec Tunnels and VPN technologies Designs, implements, and supports hybrid cloud network connectivity to Microsoft Azure and/or AWS, including ExpressRoute, Azure Virtual WAN, AWS Direct Connect, and Transit Gateway architectures Manages and troubleshoots cloud-based network security groups (NSGs), virtual network peering, and cloud firewall policies Supports migration of on-premises network services to cloud and hybrid environments Collaborates with infrastructure and application teams to ensure optimal cloud network architecture, performance, and security Implements and supports network monitoring systems using technologies like SNMP, NetFlow, and syslog for monitoring and analysis Develops and maintains network automation scripts using Powershell and Ansible to streamline network operations and improve efficiency Qualifications Skills & Competencies Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex network issues Very strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking Strong knowledge of network security and firewall administration. Palo Alto / Panorama experience a plus Strong knowledge of routing and switching in a large enterprise environment. Arista and Cisco experience a plus Strong knowledge and experience administering a large, multi-site LAN/WAN network, including data centers interconnections (DCI) Strong Knowledge of dynamic LAN/WAN
